svg.title: One Flow, two storage choices
svg.desc: Local storage: FlowJoe manages the Flow and imported media on this computer.; Workspace folder: A folder holds the Flow and shared files. Back it up or sync it with your own tools.. Private content stays on its original computer. A portable .fj export is a separate copy, not the live folder.
